title: The Big Match under translation-invariant charges
summary: We study two-player zero-sum stochastic games in which a stream of stage payoffs is evaluated by a translation-invariant charge on the set of stages. Every patient valuation, that is, every diffuse charge that obeys the time value of money principle, is translation-invariant, and by Mertens and Neyman each player has, for every $\varepsilon>0$, a strategy that is $\varepsilon$-optimal for all patient valuations simultaneously.
